build_processor_factory: build a python module that uses get_processor_factory to create a GAT processor with 8 attention heads
create_gat_processor: create a GAT processor instance with 128 output size and 4 attention heads for graph attention
run_pgn_inference: run a PGN processor inference step with node features, edge features, and adjacency matrix inputs
create_gatv2_processor: create a GATv2 processor instance with residual connections and layer normalization enabled
build_memnet_processor: build a MemNetMasked processor with 128 memory size and 2 hops for end-to-end memory networks
